slides.text: The **US ambassador** said in a press release, via Borkena, that the US backs **Tigray's** recovery after a **Mekelle** visit.
The UN says the **World Food Programme** began food aid on **Nov 11** for families who fled **Moyale** to Kenya.
Addis Standard reports a **diaspora rally** at the **US State Department** on **Nov 16** (single source).
